lines.speaker: stallholder_ben
lines.text: Everything here fell off something. I don't ask what, you don't ask how, we both do very well.

lines.speaker: stallholder_ben
lines.text: Prototype boards, mostly. Campus up the hill throws out more in a month than this street sells in a year.

lines.speaker: stallholder_ben
lines.text: You keep buying the old analog stuff and none of the new boards. Either you're sentimental or you know something.

lines.speaker: stallholder_ben
lines.text: Relics I'll always take. Hand-made goes up in value; mass-made goes down. Same in any century, I expect.
